name: auto-plugins
description: Auto Plugins: switches heavy, project-specific plugins (Godot, Unity, game dev, Expo, web and React Native, UI design, Minecraft modding) on for this project only when it needs them, and applies your worker-tier model presets (suggest or auto).

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn off and Auto Plugins switches nothing on. Plugins it already turned on stay on.

modelMode.title: Model presets
modelMode.description: How Auto Plugins uses your worker tiers (Haiku for very small tasks, Sonnet by default, Opus for hard tasks and UI design). off: nothing. suggest: a prompt that calls for another tier shows a note and tells Claude. auto: subagents started without a model get the tier their task calls for. Default: suggest.
